$comment: Approved license exceptions. Each record requires purl (version-pinned), license, reason, approved_by, approved_on, expires_on (max 180 days) and ticket. Protected by .github/CODEOWNERS. Free-text license names that map to an allowed SPDX id are handled by LICENSE_NAME_NORMALIZATION in the evaluator, NOT here.

exceptions.reason: Copyleft reciproco en runtime. Base45 es un algoritmo de ~100 lineas: se sustituye por implementacion propia, como se hizo con Base58 en EUD-219. NO se resuelve ampliando la allowlist

Variante de BSD-3-Clause con clausula de exclusion de uso nuclear. Sin obligaciones de copyleft, pero la identidad de la licencia no es equivalente a BSD-3-Clause, asi que no se normaliza: se admite de forma explicita y revisable

amqp-client is triple-licensed (Apache-2.0 OR GPL-2.0-only OR MPL-2.0); we consume it under Apache-2.0. The SBOM lists the three grants as separate array entries rather than a single OR expression, so the gate reads them as cumulative and blocks on the GPL-2.0-only term even though Apache-2.0 is also declared and is the one that applies here.
